decisive_items: bilateral opacification of the sphenoid and ethmoid sinuses
left intraorbital involvement with contrast enhancement
extension into the cavernous sinus causing pachymeningeal enhancement
response.rationale: Acute invasive fungal sinusitis is most likely in an immunocompromised patient (chronic high-dose prednisone) with sinus opacification, orbital apex/cavernous sinus extension, and rapid progression.

rejected.why: Metastatic disease is less likely given the acute infectious-appearing sinusitis pattern and immunosuppression, though cancer history makes it a consideration.
Granulomatosis with polyangiitis is less likely without pulmonary/renal involvement and given the fulminant course in an immunocompromised host.
Tolosa-Hunt is a diagnosis of exclusion and does not explain bilateral sinus opacification or the invasive pattern in this setting.
